comment: Share of requests per endpoint, in percent; each mix adds up to 100. Read by perf/k6/load.js (the load) and perf/run.ps1 (data sizing). Optional checks (every N-th request, 0 or absent = off): finishEvery = /progress to a team that completes during the run (TEAM_COMPLETED expected afterwards), replayEvery = a /progress resent with the same Idempotency-Key, reclaimEvery = a /claim repeated by a user who already claimed (ALREADY_CLAIMED expected); perf/k6/load.js explains them.

read-heavy.description: players mostly looking at their team

mixed.description: a typical session, including teams completing, retried requests and repeated claims

write-heavy.description: stress for row locks, idempotency inserts and cache invalidation

get-only.description: the read path alone; without writes no team is invalidated

join-only.description: the join path alone: how many joins per second the join cursor row allows
